findings: The complete 2026-11-07 capture retains the stated capability of accepting an in-person payment and saving payment details for later when the customer is absent. It supplies only the Server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native companion routes for implementation.

The 2026-05-01 five-variant full capture remains the available detail authority for consent, the PaymentIntent flow, account representation, and the generated-card conditions. The new index does not establish current version or eligibility conditions.
Add the dated 2026-11-07 raw index as a navigation pointer where useful and correct existing historical summary and concept overstatements from the older evidence.
substantive_changes: The contraction in the overview is presentational. The newly enumerated `.md` platform links and Index heading are navigation. The detailed text omitted in the newer representation establishes no change to functionality.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The merchant represents the customer with Customers v1 or a customer-configured Accounts v2 object. The 2026-05-01 capture identifies Accounts v2 as generally available for Connect users and public preview for other users, with a preview API version for preview users.

A card_present PaymentIntent uses setup_future_usage=on_session if reuse is only while the customer is present and off_session otherwise. The consenting customer pays via the reader; the integration passes allow_redisplay=always or limited at collection/processing. The past mandatory dates were March 31, 2025 for non-React Native and September 30, 2025 for React Native.

A successful payment with a future-use-capable method returns requires_capture or succeeded. Retrieve the distinct reusable card PaymentMethod from latest_charge.payment_method_details.card_present.generated_card, automatically attached if the Customer ID was passed on creation and manually attachable otherwise.
Preserve the dated server-driven Stripe-Version: 2024-09-30.acacia and Preview collect_payment_method qualification with separate confirmation, iOS SDK 4.3.0+ and Android SDK 4.0.0+.

Original payment is card-present; generated-card follow-ups are CNP and lack card-present pricing and liability-shift benefits. Verify generated_card rather than guaranteeing it or excluding all wallets. For saved wallet use, preserve limited redisplay and off_session=true confirmation, with Apple Pay/Google Pay re-prompt for customer-present checkout. If a reusable method is necessary and absent, use save-directly with a different method or refund and retry with a different one.
conflicts: The source lines 17 and 21 and the Save After Payment concept treat savings from qualifying flows as definite or digital wallets as categorically unable to generate cards. The older guide says some payments might not generate one and explicitly documents saved wallets for off-session confirmation with limited redisplay (old raw lines 153-166). Recast the one-flow summary as requesting a generated card, verify its presence and use fallback only if a reusable method is necessary.

Source line 18 and concept lines 30 and 60 say ‘no liability shift’ broadly. The old guide says card-present features, including card-present liability-shift and pricing benefits, do not apply to subsequent CNP generated-card transactions (old raw line 21).

unresolved_questions: The 2026-11-07 target bodies are outside the evidence packet, so no implementation, support, Preview/GA or version changes for any platform variant are determined by the new capture.

answers.Q1: The 2026-11-07 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-after-payment says the merchant can accept an in-person payment and save payment details for later customer-absent use and directs integrators to five implementations (new raw lines 1-17). The index itself supplies no consent terms, generated-card state transition, object assignment or API/SDK prerequisite. The 2026-05-01 details retained by source-stripe-terminal-save-after-payment document a customer represented by a Customer or customer-configured Account, the PaymentIntent setup_future_usage distinction, and passing consent-appropriate allow_redisplay after customer consent at processing or collection (old raw lines 29-31, old raw lines 69-73 and old raw lines 94-102). The PaymentIntent following a successful future-use-capable payment is requires_capture or succeeded, and the reusable card is retrieved from the expanded latest charge and automatically attached if the Customer ID was provided at creation (old raw lines 153-157). The existing summary has those main routes but overstates absence from wallets: the same guide says some digital-wallet payments might not generate a card and covers saved-wallet off-session use with limited redisplay (old raw lines 153-166).
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-after-payment, the 2026-11-07 change from “is not” to “isn't” is presentational (old raw line 6 and new raw line 7), and the explicit Server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native links are navigation (new raw lines 9-17). The 2026-05-01 full text and source-stripe-terminal-save-after-payment remain the historical implementation route, with the 2026-11-07 index as a dated raw_reference and the reciprocal stripe-terminal-save-payment-details concept link, Stripe index route and save-directly companion retained. No substantive behavior change follows from the missing bodies. Preserve the 2026-05-01 Accounts v2 GA/preview scope (old raw lines 8-14), mandatory allow_redisplay dates of March 31, 2025 for non-React Native and September 30, 2025 for React Native (old raw line 23), the historical Server-driven 2024-09-30.acacia header and collect_payment_method Preview with separate confirmation (old raw lines 94-102 and old raw lines 136-138), and iOS/Android SDK minimums of 4.3.0+/4.0.0+ (old raw lines 371-377 and old raw lines 522-528). Correct the summary and concept wording about potentially missing generated cards and off-session-only saved wallets (old raw lines 153-166), and scope the lost liability-shift/pricing benefits to card-present ones (old raw line 21).
